title: Coordinatewise monotonicity implies monotonicity
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. If, for every coordinate $i$ and every input $x$, changing coordinate $i$ from $-1$ to $1$ does not decrease the value of $f$, then $f$ is monotone on the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the two signs
For every coordinate and input, replacing that coordinate by $-1$ and then by $1$ gives values in nondecreasing order
